review_scope: PDF page 1 overview; page 2 Table 1 base AFR rows (12 cells); page 4 Table 5 section 7520 rate. All proposed cells checked against locally rendered PDF pages.
verification_method: Direct official IRS PDF read plus visual inspection of locally rendered pages 1, 2 and 4 using pdftoppm; each proposed numeric cell checked with its visible row and column label. Extracted text was not the sole numeric evidence.

visual_checks.verified: Ruling identity, October 2026 label and separate Table 1 section 1274(d)/Table 5 section 7520 purposes

limits: No entire PDF, screenshot or publisher prose stored in corpus or repository
No numeric input outside the visually checked cells
Month scope does not establish transaction applicability or universal date bounds
